business_problem: However, as a startup, building their own LLM presented a number of practical constraints.
solution_summary: Scatter Lab, a conversational AI startup, is transforming entertainment with their AI-powered B2C platform. Since launching in 2023, their flagship chatbots, Iruda and Nutty, have driven 2 million downloads and 1.1 billion conversations. Their latest innovation, Zeta, blends AI-driven storytelling, character customization and immersive engagement to enhance chat experiences. However, development budget constraints posed a challenge. With Databricks, Scatter Lab built a large language model (LLM) in just three months, fueling rapid growth — 1.5 million users within nine months, each spending over 12 hours per week on Zeta. Now, the company is poised for global growth, including expansion into Japan.
business_outcome: Scatter Lab achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 3 Months To build a proprietary LLM with Databricks; 1.5 Million Users Secured in just nine months after launching; 12 Hours Of average weekly engagement on Zeta.
